description: Activate when the user asks about the current state of a specific VTEX account — what is configured, what is active, what has been implemented. Use for questions like "what carriers do we have configured?", "what promotions are currently active?", "what apps are installed?", "how is our shipping set up?", "what does our account architecture look like?", or "what trade policies exist?". Do NOT activate for questions about how the platform works in general (use vtex-expert for that) or for architecture design decisions (use vtex-architect for those).
